---
title: "The Wealth Delta Tax"
---

The Wealth Delta Tax (WDT) is a proposed fiscal mechanism that levies a progressive annual
charge on changes in individual net worth above an exemption threshold, combined with a
symmetric loss-refund mechanism and a pre-funded Sovereign Wealth Fund.

This site hosts the full companion paper series. Use the sidebar to navigate by paper.

## About the project

The WDT is designed for developed capitalist democracies. Its governing objective is to
redesign the fiscal relationship between concentrated private wealth and democratic society
while preserving productive dynamism and progressively reducing the tax burden on ordinary
households.

The project currently comprises 24 papers covering mechanism design, valuation, governance,
rates and revenue, behavioural robustness, political architecture, and strategic adoption
dynamics.

## Where to start

- **New to the WDT?** Begin with the [White Paper](wp.html) for the mechanism overview.
- **Want the normative case first?** The [Moral Foundations](mf.html) paper develops
  the philosophical basis independently of the mechanism.
- **Returning reader?** Use the sidebar to navigate directly to the paper you want.
